current: Zahtevek spletnemu mestu za podporo poslan.
rationale: Source "Request to support site submitted" means a request was submitted (to the team) to support this site; the Slovenian dative "Zahtevek spletnemu mestu" says the request was sent to the website.
suggest: Zahtevek za podporo spletnemu mestu poslan.
summary: The translation reverses the meaning: the request is to add support for the site, not a request sent to the site.

rationale: The source button dismisses the message; "V redu" means "OK", not "dismiss".

rationale: The locale uses the formal register; "Končam" is a first-person informal-style rendering, inconsistent with the source's neutral "Exit Private Browsing?".
summary: First-person verb form used instead of the neutral/impersonal question typical for dialog prompts in the formal register.

rationale: The quoted menu item must match the actual menu string menu_add_to_home_screen; also, the adjective form should be consistent with that item's wording.
summary: Curly quotes in the source are rendered as straight double quotes but the app name placeholder is also declined with an appended suffix; the quoting style should match the house straight-double convention consistently.

rationale: The source "Share…" has no space before the ellipsis; Slovenian typography also attaches the ellipsis directly to the word.
summary: Space inserted before the ellipsis character.

current: Aplikacije vam ni potrebno niti odpreti
rationale: With an infinitive the correct impersonal construction is "ni treba"; "ni potrebno" is a well-known non-standard usage.
suggest: Aplikacije vam ni treba niti odpreti
summary: "ni potrebno" should be "ni treba" in standard Slovenian.

rationale: The set of placeholders must match the source: a missing one drops a value the user should see, an extra one throws.
summary: `onboarding_first_screen_title` has placeholders %s where the source has %1$s

rationale: The source means the theme is determined by the Battery Saver setting; the Slovenian reads as a command to set/configure the battery saver, i.e. the battery saver becomes the object rather than the agent.

rationale: Source is "Remove custom URLs" (plural, screen for removing multiple URLs); the target is singular.
summary: Plural "custom URLs" translated as singular.

current: Za ta spletna mesta ste onemogočili zavračanje vsebine.
rationale: Focus uses "blokiranje vsebine" for content blocking; "zavračanje vsebine" is a different term used inconsistently.
suggest: Za ta spletna mesta ste onemogočili blokiranje vsebine.
summary: "disabled content blocking" is translated as "onemogočili zavračanje vsebine" but with a term inconsistent with the rest; more importantly the sense of blocking is rendered oddly.

current: Za večjo varnost poskuša samodejno vzpostaviti povezavo s šifrirnim protokolom HTTPS.

summary: The translation drops "to sites" from "connect to sites using the HTTPS encryption protocol".

rationale: The source title "HTTPS-Only Mode" contains no quotation marks; the added quotes are gratuitous.
summary: Uses straight double quotes where the source has none and Slovenian typography would use „ “ or none at all.

rationale: The developer comment says this links to Focus licensing information; "dovoljenja" means permissions, while software licences are "licence".
summary: "Licensing information" is rendered as "Podatki o dovoljenjih" (permissions), not licences.

rationale: The developer comment describes Stealth mode as hiding app content; "skrivni" (secret) suggests private browsing, which is a different Focus concept.
summary: "Stealth" is translated as "Skrivni način" (secret mode) rather than a stealth/hidden-mode term matching the feature name.

rationale: The source restricts blocking to cross-site cookies; "spletne piškotke" means simply "web cookies", i.e. all cookies, which is a different (and misleading) setting.
summary: "Block cross-site cookies" is rendered as "Zavračaj spletne piškotke" (block web cookies), losing the "cross-site" qualifier.

rationale: The source is a polite option label paired with "No thanks" (translated "Ne, hvala"); the Slovenian loses the politeness marker and changes the punctuation.
summary: "Yes please" is translated as "Da!", dropping the polite "please" and adding an exclamation mark.

current: Zavrni morebitne nevarne in zavajajoče strani
rationale: "morebitne nevarne" stacks two adjectives ungrammatically; the intended sense is "potentially dangerous" ("morebiti/morebitno nevarne"). Other Block* titles use the imperfective "Zavračaj".
suggest: Zavračaj morebitno nevarne in zavajajoče strani
summary: Adjective agreement error: "Zavrni morebitne nevarne" should be "morebiti nevarne", and the verb form is inconsistent with the other block-preference titles.

rationale: Terminology for "top sites" should be consistent across the Top Sites section (remove_top_site/rename_top_site context).
summary: "Top sites" is translated as "glavne strani", inconsistent with the top-site strings elsewhere in the file.

current: Nameščeni iskalnik že uporablja to ime.

rationale: Slovene style guides prefer "prek"; "Deli preko" is a colloquialism.

rationale: This is a tracker category label; "Družbeni" alone is an incomplete adjective with no noun and does not name the category the way other categories do.
